d:
Makar sankranti ka mauka ho to hava men til gur ke sath ek aur saundhi khushbu tairne lagti hai..ye khushbu hai bhagalpuri katarni chure ki jiske bina bihariyon ki makar sankrati adhuri hai. sankranti ka nam aate hi bihar ke gharon men dahi-chura, tilkut aur gur ki mithas yad aane lagti hai. halanki maujuda samay men is khushbu ke bhavishy par sankat ke badal mandrate najar aa rahe hain.
